name: AI Tools Explained
bildvorlage: {einstellung} of {motiv} as the clear focal subject, {aktion}, in {ort}, {epoche}
bildstil_prompt: Realistic hand-painted digital painting, open-world-game key art look: lifelike faces, thin linework only around figures, rich material textures, deep warm contrast, soft depth of field, visible brushwork. Vivid, warm, inviting and richly filled; present-day 2020s world: modern home offices, glass-walled startup offices, coworking spaces and neon-lit night cities, current laptops, phones and monitors, contemporary clothing and architecture. Original fictional characters. One clear focal action in the central 60 percent, coherent perspective and plausible present-day tech props. Natural anatomy, simple readable hand poses, distinct objects. Plain unmarked surfaces.

winkel: the trending AI topic itself - what just happened, what it lets you do now, and an honest limitation
AI that saves you money - what it costs, what the free option already does, and when paying is worth it; prices only from official pricing pages

erzaehlstimme.stil: hyped, energetic tech creator in his early twenties, talking fast to a friend, genuinely amazed and a bit over the top, big emphasis on surprising words, almost breathless at twists, still clear when explaining steps
erzaehlstimme.gewaehlt: 2026-10-19 Hoerprobe Stimme 1 (Puck), Nutzer: junge Stimme klingt authentischer
erzaehlstimme.geaendert: 2026-10-29 Emotionsprobe 40940368441, Nutzer: "Kombi von Stimme 7/8 ... aber wenig lachen" -> Regie je Abschnitt (Schock/Spannung/Fluestern/Triumph + Ironie), keine Lach-Laute. 2026-10-29 Nutzer: "Energie gut, aber noch hoeher mit Uebertreibung" - vorher casual/relaxed; 2026-11-06 Hoerprobe Tempo (42193971728), Nutzer: "Stimme 3" -> starke Kontraste je Abschnitt (laut - leise - Fluestern - Pause - Explosion), Text kuerzer (woerter_pro_sekunde 3.0 -> 2.4), weil jedes KI-Video 02.-06.11. auf x1.11-1.25 beschleunigt wurde

regie.hook: explosive comedic disbelief on the very first word, loud and fast, then a sharp stop
regie.frage: suddenly quiet and conspiratorial, leaning into the mic, slow and teasing
regie.beleg: quick, punchy, smug, hit the quoted numbers hard
regie.erklaerung: mock-serious newsreader, deadpan, every quote crisp
regie.wendung: whisper the first words, hold a long dramatic pause, then the last line explodes
regie.aufloesung: big triumphant grin you can hear, warm and energetic, clear call to action
